verdict.rationale: cubic ships several autonomous background automations: it auto-starts PR reviews on install (cubic-docs-4, cubic-docs-41), can auto-approve clean PRs under policy (cubic-docs-12, cubic-docs-35), runs codebase scans deploying many AI agents (cubic-docs-21), keeps an AI wiki current via rolling PRs (cubic-docs-23), does cross-repo checks (cubic-docs-37), and auto-purchases flex capacity to keep reviews running (cubic-docs-24) — all without manual triggering. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined scheduled/cron-style custom automations beyond PR-triggered events, and independent hands-on confirmation that these autonomous flows run reliably unattended.
